scope: Prepared isolated Close Ptrk registration test extension; no production edits or worker build
precondition: Use root-owned actual Display selected getter and GuiModel lazy auxiliary-pointer identity list helpers after declarations are released.
retained_tests: Keep all17 existing tests. Missing Display binding still guards after allocation; no earlier contract weakened.

cases.name: qualified missing and null global Display differ
checks: Unavailable optional and empty qualification refuse after cache allocation.
Qualified null owner returns with the cached graph intact for both graph flag false and true.
Clearing the binding restores the guard.

cases.name: new graph registers before constructor-false return
checks: Selected model may have no StateVar; graph allocation and actual auxiliary registry insertion complete.
Emitting model remains unregistered when it differs from the actual selected model.
No StateVar is allocated merely to return on graph flag false.

cases.name: cached graph registers once in each current selected model
checks: Repeated calls preserve graph identity and avoid another same-pointer append.
Changing the actual Display main selection registers the same cached pointer in the new model.
Earlier model membership remains.

cases.name: selected zero variable permits enabled graph return
checks: Actual selected StateVar variable0 succeeds even when the emitting StateVar is nonzero.
Registration occurred and both variables/graph flags remain unchanged.

cases.name: selected nonzero variable retains graph update guard
checks: Emitting variable0 does not skip the selected model nonzero branch.
Guard occurs before30ad90, after actual graph registration.
Variable values, graph flags and earlier mutations survive.

cases.name: selected missing StateVar guards at lazy constructor
checks: After explicit graph flag true, selected missing StateVar refuses at c905b0.
Actual auxiliary membership persists; no detached StateVar or application/read side effects.

cases.name: manager off skips actual owner and registration
checks: False live manager flag returns before allocating graph or model auxiliary wrapper.
Missing global binding does not become a new requirement for the off leaf.

cases.name: ordered receivers stop only at reached unresolved branch
checks: An earlier enabled new graph registers and returns on graph false.
A later preexisting enabled graph registers before its selected nonzero-variable guard.
Subsequent manager has no cache allocation or list entry.

cases.name: manager cache destruction preserves raw model membership
checks: Deleting cache does not erase its pointer identity from the model registry.
The test does not dereference the stale pointer.
Model reset preserves the registry, matching separate root helper tests.

qualification: Tests use declared adapter fixtures, not original execution or public Close parity. Root owns all builds and integration.
